Newborough Warren · Reproducible analysis

Pipeline index

Every script in the analysis pipeline: what it does, what it reads, which scripts it feeds and which documents use its results. · Back to the project page

The pipeline runs these scripts in order, phase by phase. Each entry starts with what the script does, then where its inputs come from (other scripts' results, or data collected outside the pipeline), which later scripts use its results, and which of the project's documents draw on them. The script names are the keys: click one to jump to its entry.

Left border: blue for an analytical step, sand for a display or utility step, green for a diagnostic.

How this page is made

It is generated, never edited by hand, by tools/build_pipeline_index.py, and the project's checks fail if it falls behind. Each part comes from a record the pipeline already keeps:

  • Steps, phases and tiers from the step registry in run_analysis.py (outputs/pipeline_manifest.json).
  • Reads and feeds from outputs/pipeline_provenance.json, which records the files every step read and wrote on the last full run. One step feeds another wherever the second read a file the first wrote.
  • Used in from the project's provenance ledger (figures and tables) and citation index (numbers quoted in the text).
  • What it does from the first line of each script's own description.
